workItem: Owner-directed CI cost-control: PR class R keeps required build-and-test context and scoped validation but skips production artifact build steps; main push remains force-full.
securityBoundary: Preserve the required build-and-test check, trusted-main classification, integrity, dependency audit, lint, unit tests and workflow-security semantics. Only PR-side production artifact build/predeploy/docker-image steps are skipped for class R; force-full main push remains unchanged.
reuseBoundary: Reuse existing classifyPrScope outputs and ci.yml conditional steps; do not create a second CI job, workflow, reporter or authority.
externalMutationScope: Repository branch commits only. No workflow mutation, merge, deployment, Render, Supabase, Stripe or production mutation.
releaseCondition: Release when the associated Pull Request is Human-merged, closed, superseded or the work item is explicitly abandoned.
